podcast.title: Marfan Syndrome
podcast.body: Bradford Cox, the lead singer of the indie band Deerhunter, has Marfan Syndrome, a genetic disorder affecting the body's connective tissues. This condition is characterized by individuals tending to be tall and thin, with long arms, legs, fingers, and toes, as well as being exceptionally flexible in their joints. "Bradford Cox is the lead singer of an indie band called Dear Hunter."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Marfan Syndrome
podcast.body: Bradford Cox suffers from Marfan Syndrome, a genetic disorder that affects the body's connective tissue and can lead to physical traits like being tall and thin with long limbs, as well as potential scoliosis and heart conditions. "Bradford Cox of the band Dear Hunter has Marfan's."
